liebermann.notes: Cotton Otho A XVI, now burnt, which contained 'Leges Gul. conq.' — probably Wl art and/or ECf retr — together with the Genealogia Normannica to Stephen, i.e. the Tripartita.

entries.text_de: Cotton Otho A XVI, jetzt verbrannt, enthielt f. 1 Leges Gul. conq. — d. i. wohl Wl art und (oder?) ECf retr, u. S. 486. 627 — sammt Geneal. Normann. bis Stephan12, also Tripartita.
entries.text_en: Cotton Otho A XVI, now burnt, contained f. 1 Leges Gul. conq. — i.e. probably Wl art and (or?) ECf retr, below, pp. 486. 627 — together with Geneal. Normann. to Stephen12, thus Tripartita.
